import ctypes
import os

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the return type and argument types for the gsl_sf_erfc function
gsl.gsl_sf_erfc.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_sf_erfc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]

def compute_erfc(x):
    """Compute the complementary error function using GSL."""
    return gsl.gsl_sf_erfc(ctypes.c_double(x))

def assert_test():
    # Test cases
    assert abs(compute_erfc(0.0) - 1.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert abs(compute_erfc(1.0) - 0.15729920705028513) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert abs(compute_erfc(2.0) - 0.004677734981047266) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed"
    assert abs(compute_erfc(-1.0) - 1.8427007929497149) < 1e-9, "Test case 4 failed"
    assert abs(compute_erfc(3.0) - 0.000022090496998585441) < 1e-9, "Test case 5 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
